prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent nine-pose character sheet for an original tactical RPG. One original adult Fire Nation deserter, visibly distinct from a grey-haired provincial captain or any youthful hero.
Subject identity: lean but physically credible adult man in his late thirties, warm brown skin, short closely cropped black hair with a receding temple line, clean shaven, tired sharp face and sober wary expression. His signature silhouette is a short worn red officer tunic with squared standing collar, forearms exposed beneath rolled sleeves, brown cross-body strap and small closed oil-flask pouch at the hip. Dark charcoal trousers, wrapped lower legs, practical brown boots. No helmet, beard, cape, hair ponytail, armor plates, or ornate insignia. Fire red #d1462f with dusty rust shadows; leather brown, charcoal and very sparing brass fastening.
Style: hand-drawn clean thin warm dark-brown ink #1b1410 and restrained two-tone cel shading, same economical illustrated game-character grammar as an animated martial-arts adventure. Natural adult proportions, not cute, not chibi, not a procedural stick figure. No gradients, photoreal texture, glow halos or thick black outlines. Every frame remains clearly readable at 75px character height. Three-quarter elevated game view roughly30 degrees above horizontal, all poses face screen-right.
Sheet layout: EXACT three equal columns by three equal rows, 1536x2304 preferred, portrait2:3 canvas. One full-body pose in each cell with large truly transparent gutters. Identical scale and identity in all nine cells. Feet on consistent baseline. Both entire boots, body and hands remain well inside every cell. Maintain attached natural wrists and anatomically credible hands throughout. No weapons held in hands, no sword anywhere. Hands empty, casting effects will be added by the game.
Row1 left: idleA, calm balanced stance facing right, hands loosely poised at belt/chest height. Row1 center: idleB, same planted feet and posture with only subtle breathing change. Row1 right: walkA, NEAR LEG planted under body and FAR KNEE bent visibly forward in a passing step, near arm naturally behind and far arm forward.
Row2 left: walkB, FAR LEG planted under body and NEAR KNEE bent visibly forward in the opposite passing step, arms reverse naturally. This must be a genuinely opposite planted leg from walkA, not the same silhouette translated or mirrored. Row2 center: cast0, weight gathers onto rear leg, torso turns back slightly, right casting elbow drawn back with open right hand beside ribs, left hand guards chest. Row2 right: cast1, weight moves into a controlled forward lunge, right arm extends decisively toward screen-right at chest level, open palm and fingers aimed forward, left hand stays near torso; a physically plausible unarmed fire-release or forward throwing gesture.
Row3 left: cast2, right arm lowering and torso returning to balance after release, empty hands, clear recovery toward idle. Row3 center: hit0, believable backward recoil, one boot lifting slightly, arms responding naturally, identity unchanged. Row3 right: ko0, on one knee with bowed head and one supporting hand on knee, genuinely shorter than standing rather than enlarged, no gore.
No flames, particles, projectiles, fireballs, floating accessories, ground shadow, floor, background scenery, captions, labels, cell borders, text, logos, watermark, checkerboard or reference figures. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND. Only the nine isolated painted figures belong in the output.
